AHRR.summary: Represses AHR-mediated transcription of xenobiotic enzymes. AHRR hypomethylation (cg05575921) is a primary EWAS hallmark of tobacco smoke exposure, systemic inflammation, and accelerated epigenetic aging.

references.citation: Monick et al., Am J Med Genet B 2012

ZBTB16.fullName: Zinc Finger and BTB Domain Containing 16 (PLZF)
ZBTB16.summary: Transcriptional repressor directly downstream of glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) activation. Regulates immune cell development, neural progenitor differentiation, and stress-induced metabolic adaptation.

HTR2A.summary: Encodes the G-protein coupled serotonin 2A receptor, highly expressed in prefrontal cortex. Key mediator of mood, cognition, hallucination, anxiety, and fear extinction learning.

FKBP5.summary: Acts as an ultra-short negative feedback regulator of the glucocorticoid receptor (GR). Childhood trauma-dependent FKBP5 demethylation impairs GR sensitivity and leads to chronic HPA axis dysregulation.

NR3C1.fullName: Nuclear Receptor Subfamily 3 Group C Member 1 (Glucocorticoid Receptor)
NR3C1.summary: Encodes the primary glucocorticoid receptor (GR), mediating stress hormone response, immune suppression, and brain synaptic plasticity. Promoter exon 1F methylation is a classic epigenetic marker of stress exposure.

BDNF.summary: Promotes neuronal survival, synaptic plasticity, hippocampal neurogenesis, and fear conditioning memory consolidation. Methylation changes impair activity-dependent BDNF expression.

SDK1.summary: Transmembrane cell adhesion molecule guiding synaptic specificity and dendritic arborization. Identified as a genome-wide significant risk locus in large-scale PTSD GWAS meta-analyses.

references.citation: Stein et al., Am J Psychiatry 2021

CRH.summary: The master hypothalamic neurohormone driving stress-induced pituitary ACTH release and cortisol secretion. Hyper-secretion of CRH in central amygdala mediates fear and hyperarousal.

references.citation: Bremner et al., Am J Psychiatry 1997

SGK1.summary: Serine/threonine kinase rapidly transcribed by glucocorticoids. Regulates hippocampal dendritic spine density, glutamate receptor trafficking, and cellular survival in response to stress.

references.citation: Anacker et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci 2013

GAD1.summary: Catalyzes the rate-limiting conversion of glutamate to GABA. Deficits in GABAergic cortical inhibition are central to stress-induced hyperexcitability and trauma memory extinction deficits.

references.citation: Akbarian et al., Arch Gen Psychiatry 1995

COMT.summary: Degrades catecholamines including dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine in prefrontal cortex. The functional Val158Met polymorphism regulates executive function, stress resilience, and fear processing.

references.citation: Kolassa et al., J Clin Psychopharmacol 2010
Egan et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci 2001

MAOA.summary: Degrades serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine in neural tissue. Epigenetic promoter methylation interacts with early life maltreatment to influence aggression, impulsive violence, and mood disorders.

references.citation: Ziegler et al., Int J Neuropsychopharmacol 2016

ADAP1.summary: GTPase-activating protein for ARF6, participating in dendritic spine morphogenesis, endocytosis, and intracellular vesicular transport in central neurons. Top cross-subtype DMR in meta-analysis.

references.citation: Venkateswarlu et al., J Biol Chem 2004

DRD4.summary: G-protein coupled receptor for dopamine, abundant in limbic system and prefrontal cortex. Regulates attention, reward processing, novelty seeking, and emotional reactivity.

FAAH.summary: Primary degrading enzyme for anandamide (AEA). Inhibition or genetic variant (C385A) elevates brain endocannabinoid tone, enhancing fear extinction memory and stress resilience.

HTR3A.summary: Ligand-gated ion channel mediating rapid excitatory serotonin responses. Strongly expressed in amygdala and prefrontal cortex GABA interneurons, modulating anxiety and stress reactivity.

NR3C2.fullName: Nuclear Receptor Subfamily 3 Group C Member 2 (Mineralocorticoid Receptor)
NR3C2.summary: High-affinity steroid receptor for cortisol/aldosterone. Regulates baseline basal HPA axis tone, spatial memory, and early appraisal of stress stimuli.

ARC.summary: Immediate early gene essential for long-term potentiation (LTP), AMPA receptor trafficking, and consolidation of trauma memory tracings in amygdala and hippocampus.

NPY1R.summary: G-protein coupled receptor mediating anxiolytic and stress-resilient actions of Neuropeptide Y (NPY) in amygdala. NPY-Y1R signaling counteracts CRH-driven stress hyperarousal.

NPY2R.summary: Presynaptic autoreceptor regulating feedback inhibition of NPY and GABA release in arcuate nucleus and amygdala.

references.citation: Tasan et al., Br J Pharmacol 2016

OPRM1.summary: Primary target for endogenous beta-endorphin and opioid analgesics. Regulates social attachment, emotional pain processing, stress-induced analgesia, and addiction vulnerability.

ADCYAP1R1.summary: Receptor for pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP). Identified as a female-specific PTSD risk biomarker mediating fear conditioning and HPA activation.

AVPR1A.summary: Mediates vasopressin actions on social bonding, territorial aggression, HPA axis potentiating, and stress-induced vasoconstriction.

references.citation: Walum et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci 2008

PRKCE.summary: Calcium-independent kinase modulating GABA-A receptor sensitivity, neurosteroid biosynthesis, and stress-induced hyperalgesia.

NGF.summary: Essential neurotrophic factor driving sympathetic neuron maintenance, basal forebrain cholinergic integrity, and stress-induced neurogenic inflammation.

DNMT3B.summary: Primary de novo DNA methyltransferase establishing novel epigenetic methylation patterns in response to environmental trauma, stress, and pharmacological intervention.

references.citation: Oliveira et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci 2012

ANKRD55.summary: Immune-related loci identified in large-scale EWAS and GWAS of autoimmune diseases and PTSD symptom clusters.

references.citation: Mehta et al., Am J Psychiatry 2019

HDAC2.summary: Negative regulator of hippocampal spine formation and synaptic plasticity. HDAC2 overexpression impairs trauma extinction and memory recall.

CREB1.summary: Central transcription factor driving BDNF expression, long-term memory formation, and neuroplasticity downstream of cAMP/PKA cascades.

references.citation: Blendy et al., Nat Rev Neurosci 2006

HTR2C.summary: Serotonin 2C receptor regulating HPA axis activation, appetite, anxiety, and impulsive behavior. RNA editing and methylation tune receptor sensitivity.

references.citation: Iwamoto et al., Hum Mol Genet 2009

DRD5.summary: D1-like dopamine receptor subtype coupled to Gs, highly expressed in hippocampus and dentate gyrus. Regulates synaptic potentiation and spatial fear memory.

NRXN1.summary: Presynaptic cell adhesion molecule organizing synaptic terminal assembly and neurotransmitter release alignment across synaptic clefts.

references.citation: Rujescu et al., Hum Mol Genet 2009

SHANK2.fullName: SH3 And Multiple Ankyrin Repeat Domains 2
SHANK2.summary: Master postsynaptic density scaffold protein anchoring glutamate receptors (NMDA/AMPA) to actin cytoskeleton in dendritic spines.

CREB5.summary: BZIP transcription factor family member regulating cAMP-dependent gene transcription in neural progenitor cells and stress pathways.

MAD1L1.category: Cell Cycle & PTSD GWAS Risk Locus
MAD1L1.summary: Cell cycle checkpoint protein identified as a prominent genome-wide significant risk locus for PTSD and schizophrenia in multi-ethnic GWAS cohorts.

PARK2.fullName: Parkin RBR E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase (PRKN)
PARK2.summary: E3 ubiquitin ligase crucial for mitochondrial quality control (mitophagy) and oxidative stress management in neurons.

CYP1B1.fullName: Cytochrome P450 Family 1 Subfamily B Member 1
CYP1B1.summary: Dioxin-inducible cytochrome P450 enzyme metabolizing polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and estrogen compounds downstream of AHR signaling.

RORA.summary: Nuclear hormone receptor regulating circadian clock oscillation (BMAL1 activation), neuroprotection against oxidative stress, and Purkinje cell survival.

CREBBP.summary: Essential histone acetyltransferase (HAT) acting as a transcriptional coactivator for CREB, GR, and NF-kB during memory consolidation.

NLGN1.summary: Excitatory postsynaptic adhesion molecule binding presynaptic neurexins to specify glutamatergic synapse formation and LTP.

NTF3.summary: Neurotrophic factor promoting visceral sensory neuron survival, locus coeruleus noradrenergic differentiation, and synaptic plastic strengthening.

TSC22D3.summary: Glucocorticoid-induced leucine zipper (GILZ) suppressing NF-kB transcription and pro-inflammatory cytokine production during stress.
